description.value: Mister is an artisan ice cream shop in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood, one of three Vancouver locations, specializing in made-to-order ice cream flash-frozen with liquid nitrogen for a uniquely rich, dense texture. The shop uses pure, natural ingredients sourced from local B.C. farmers and rotates seasonal flavour combinations. It offers a welcoming indoor seating area and accepts cash, credit, and debit.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (3 spaces) at 71m; stands (3 spaces) at 75m. Total: 6 spaces.

concerns: No bike parking or washroom information is available from the website or OSM tags; the listing cannot satisfy the bike parking required criterion without on-site verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating artisan ice cream shop in Yaletown with indoor seating, vegan options, and multiple payment methods — a practical and appealing refreshment stop for touring cyclists in central Vancouver.
enrichment_extras.notes: This OSM node represents the Yaletown location specifically. Two other Vancouver locations (Kitsilano at 1835 W 1st Ave and Robson at 1193 Robson Street) may have separate OSM records that should be checked for duplication.
